podcast.title: Long-Running Project and Juno Awards
podcast.body: Founded by Bill Leeb of the industrial band Front Line Assembly, Delirium has been an ongoing musical project since 1987, known for its "transcendant stuff." The project has received two Juno Awards. "Delirium has been an ongoing project since 1987, using guest appearances [...] And there have been two June Awards, too."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Notable Guest Vocalists
podcast.body: The band is known for featuring a variety of guest appearances on their tracks, including Emily Haines from Metric, Sarah McLachlan, and Matthew Sweet. "Delirium has been an ongoing project since 1987, using guest appearances, Emily Haynes of Metric, Sarah McLaughlin, and Matthew Sweet among them."
